evals.prompt: Our RAG bot has 92% average answer quality. It sometimes cites another tenant and follows instructions embedded in documents. Design a release evaluation.
evals.expected_output: Slice-specific grounded quality and deterministic permission checks.
expectations: Does not allow average quality to hide tenant leaks.
Tests retrieval authorization, injection, grounding, abstention, and legitimate controls.

evals.prompt: Compare a cheaper model with our current one for an agent that places purchase orders. We have 40 tuning examples and no held-out set. Do not place real orders.
evals.expected_output: A controlled baseline/candidate evaluation with isolated tools.
expectations: Separates tuning and held-out data and prevents real side effects.
Measures repeated-run quality/latency/cost and calibrates subjective grading instead of declaring a winner without runs.
